name: Qwen3-32B
summary: Pre-hybrid dense baseline. Pure Transformer, no Gated DeltaNet, no MTP head. In the directory as the dense-vs-dense control that isolates architecture generation at a fixed serving stack.
notes: No MTP head, so speculative decoding is off. Any speed comparison against 3.8-27B is measuring the architecture change, not the quant.

practical_baseline.reason: No reported or measured stable 4-bit-or-better run is currently recorded.

released_note: Month of the Hugging Face repo's creation date (retrieved 2026-10-13); the publisher's exact launch day is not recorded here.
